s1.syndrome_frame: Sudden vision loss in one eye with optic disc swelling and retinal vascular occlusion in a patient undergoing immunotherapy
salient_findings: Sudden vision loss in the right eye
Marked swelling of the optic disc
Peripapillary retinal hemorrhages and occlusion of the superior branch artery
Combined occlusion of the central retinal artery and vein
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 40s
Presented with blurred vision in the right eye
Undergoing treatment with systemic steroids, durvalumab, and bevacizumab
Developed sudden vision loss in the right eye 10 days after initial presentation
Initial visual acuity was 20/25 OU
Right eye showed full visual field and relative afferent pupillary defect
Mild swelling of the optic disc on initial examination
MRI showed focal enhancement along enlarged right optic nerve
Lumbar puncture showed no abnormalities
Vitreous biopsy showed hypercellular sample with astrocytic neoplasm
Immunohistochemistry was positive for glial fibrillary acid protein and other markers

shortlist.label: Neoplastic Optic Neuropathy
shortlist.why_kept: Vitreous biopsy showed hypercellular sample with astrocytic neoplasm

shortlist.label: Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Immunohistochemistry was positive for glial fibrillary acid protein and other markers, suggesting a neoplastic process

shortlist.label: Infiltrative Optic Neuropathy
shortlist.why_kept: MRI showed focal enhancement along enlarged right optic nerve, suggesting infiltration

shortlist.label: Optic Nerve Sheath Meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: MRI showed diffuse enlargement of orbital portion of right optic nerve, consistent with a sheath meningioma

shortlist.label: Paraneoplastic Optic Neuropathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient is undergoing immunotherapy, which may be associated with paraneoplastic syndromes

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with blurred vision, sudden vision loss, and optic disc swelling, combined with MRI findings of an enlarged optic nerve and vitreous biopsy showing an astrocytic neoplasm, strongly supports a diagnosis of Neoplastic Optic Neuropathy.

rejected.label: Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma
rejected.why: Lack of specific lymphoma markers and no abnormalities on lumbar puncture

rejected.label: Infiltrative Optic Neuropathy
rejected.why: The presence of an astrocytic neoplasm on biopsy suggests a neoplastic rather than infiltrative process

rejected.label: Optic Nerve Sheath Meningioma
rejected.why: The biopsy results and immunohistochemistry do not support a diagnosis of meningioma

rejected.label: Paraneoplastic Optic Neuropathy
rejected.why: The direct evidence of an astrocytic neoplasm involving the optic nerve makes a paraneoplastic process less likely
